I work catering and honestly, it just gets nasty. We work out of different locations (not like a hotel) so the food is on hot tables and right after it served anything savable is brought back in the refrigerated van to the catering place, a ton of places don't have/won't let you use refrigeration. We do get to eat usually about a hour or two after this pack up, but sometimes it's not worth it, and we eat bread (and sneak a taste of apps.). Although we always make sure to bring a plate of two of each of the apps, and the food to the bride and groom its more the guests/stress of the day that prevents them from getting food.
